settings_open_failed: Could not open the settings window: {error}
passwords_removed: Saved passwords will be deleted when you save.
password_warning_title: Save passwords to the local credential file?
password_warning_detail: Credential storage is set to Local configuration file. This server's server and SASL passwords will be stored unencrypted in {path}, readable only by your user account.
disable_sasl_first: Turn off SASL before disabling TLS.
adding_server_intro: Adding a server. Pick a suggestion or type a hostname, then press Save; nothing is added until then.
unsaved_server_changes: Server changes are not saved yet. Press Save to keep them.
no_servers_hint: Open the server list and add IRCnet or another server.
connection_intro: Choose a server. The nickname, channels and sign-in below belong to that server; several servers can be connected at once.
application_intro: How CayenChat itself starts and behaves, whichever server you use. Restoring defaults does not change the login startup, which the system keeps.
remove_server_detail: It will be disconnected if connected, and its saved passwords will be deleted.
encoding_hint: Default for this server: channel names and messages use it. A channel can use another one for its messages with /charset.
iso2022jp_char_refs: Send characters ISO-2022-JP cannot hold as numeric character references
iso2022jp_char_refs_hint: Only when a message is sent in ISO-2022-JP (this server's encoding or a channel's /charset): characters it cannot hold, such as emoji, are sent as 😀 instead of the message being refused. Other clients that do not decode them show the references as written. Applies from the next connection.
certificate_warning: Without certificate verification, the server cannot be authenticated.
auto_join_hint: Channels are joined in this order after connecting. Unchecked ones are kept but skipped.
autostart: Start CayenChat when you log in
autostart_disabled_by_user: Turned off in the system's startup settings. Check the box to turn it back on.
autostart_disabled_in_system: Turned off in the system's startup settings. Turn it back on there.
regain_ops: Rejoin channels where you are alone without operator status to get it
regain_ops_hint: If you are the only one in a channel you joined and have no operator status, CayenChat leaves and joins that channel once per connection. The channel is then created anew: its topic and plain modes (m, i, n, p, s, t) are set again, but the key, limit and ban lists are lost.
disconnect_all_detail: Every connection, and every scheduled reconnect, will be ended.
private_conversation_limit: Too many private conversations are open.
whois_avatar_off: Avatar exchange (CTCP AVATAR) is off for this server.
whois_open_failed: Could not open the WHOIS window: {error}
event_retry_refused: Automatic reconnection is off because the server refused authentication or these settings. Check the settings and reconnect.
appearance_intro: Use #RRGGBB colors. Type in a font field to filter choices; leave it empty for the default.
url_tooltip_color: Hover popup background (full URL / character reference)
url_tooltip_opacity: Hover popup background opacity (%; transparency = 100 − this)
url_tooltip_opacity_invalid: The hover popup opacity must be a number from 20 to 100.
palette_remove_hint: Click to use, right-click to remove
channel_number_modifier_hint: Modifier for jumping to the first through tenth channel. Choose Alt or Super when the desktop uses Ctrl+number for workspaces. Server numbers stay Ctrl+Alt+1..0.
send_key_hint: Only the chosen key sends a normal message; the others send nothing. Enter twice sends on a second Enter pressed within a moment; any other key, a change of channel or focus starts over. Use /notice to send a NOTICE.
notice_key_hint: Off by default: no key sends a NOTICE. The chosen key sends the draft as a NOTICE to the selected channel; /notice always works.
notice_key_clash: Ctrl+Enter is also the send key, which wins: this NOTICE key does nothing until one of them is changed.
reset_confirm_detail: Everything on this settings page returns to its default. Continue?
shortcut_press: Press the new keys (Esc to cancel)
shortcut_press_replaces: Press the new keys (replaces the current ones; Esc to cancel)
shortcut_needs_modifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Cmd with the key
shortcut_conflict_fixed: Also used by a shortcut that cannot be changed
shortcut_altgr: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on some layouts
menu_bar_auto_hide: Hide the menu bar until requested
text_key_theme_hint: Follow GTK uses Emacs keys when the desktop's gtk-key-theme is Emacs. Emacs mode adds Ctrl+A/E/B/F/D/H/K/U/W/Y and Alt+B/F/D; Select All moves to Ctrl+/ and Redo stays on Ctrl+Shift+Z.
linux_display_hint: Takes effect after restarting. On GNOME, X11 (XWayland) shows the desktop's own title bar; Wayland keeps native input methods and sharp fractional scaling. CAYENCHAT_DISPLAY=x11 or wayland overrides this.
image_previews_hint: Shows small thumbnails of direct PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP links in the channel log. While on, CayenChat downloads the linked images for the lines on screen from their servers; the link text stays as it is.
compact_urls_hint: Shortens long links in the channel log to the host and the start of the path, marked with an arrow. Hover shows the full URL in a bubble you can click to open; opening, selecting and copying use it too.
decode_char_refs: Show HTML numeric character references as characters
decode_char_refs_hint: Draws references such as 🍒 or 🍒 in received text as the characters they name. Hover shows the original text in a bubble with a button to copy it; selecting and copying use the characters shown. Named references (&) and HTML tags are left alone, and the message itself is not changed.
char_ref_origin: Converted from HTML numeric character references
reiwa_mode: Show the channel log in Reiwa mode
reiwa_mode_hint: Switches to a modern chat view with avatars.
restore_window_layout: Restore window position and size at startup
always_on_top: Keep CayenChat windows always on top
quit_detail_connected: This disconnects from the connected IRC servers and quits the application.
confirm_multiline_paste: Confirm before pasting several lines into the message box
confirm_multiline_paste_hint: Off: the lines of a pasted text are joined with spaces and inserted into the message box. On: a dialog shows the lines first, where you can edit them, add or remove a quote mark, and send them at once as a message or a NOTICE.
paste_dialog_hint: Each line is sent as its own message, one after another; empty lines are left out. Edit it here first. Enter starts a new line; Ctrl+Enter sends.
shorten_amazon_urls: Shorten a pasted long Amazon product URL
shorten_amazon_urls_hint: When you paste nothing but one long Amazon product link into the message box, it is inserted as https://<same Amazon site>/dp/<ASIN>; undo once to get the long link back. Pasted text that mixes a link with words, links that may select a variation, seller or affiliate, and short links such as amzn.to are inserted as they are.
unread_log_position_hint: Applies only when you select a channel or DM that is unread. "Previous position" keeps where you left the log (the bottom, if you were following it); "Latest message" jumps to the end and follows the bottom again. Conversations you have already read always keep their position.
user_avatars_hint: Shows a small picture beside nicknames in this server's channel log and member list when the server supplies one. While on, CayenChat downloads the pictures of the users on screen from their servers. Applies when you save, without reconnecting.
language_hint: System language follows your operating system; other languages use English.
diagnostics_heading: Connection diagnostics (→ sent / ← received; includes message bodies)
port_invalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
event_op_regain_rejoining: Only you are in {channel} and you lost operator status. Leaving and joining it again to get operator status back.
event_op_regained_modes: Operator status in {channel} is back; the channel modes were set again.
event_op_regained_topic: Operator status in {channel} is back; the topic was set again.
event_op_regained_modes_topic: Operator status in {channel} is back; the channel modes and topic were set again.
event_op_restore_failed_modes_topic: Operator status in {channel} is back, but the server did not confirm that the channel modes and topic were set again; check them.
event_op_restore_failed_modes: Operator status in {channel} is back, but the server did not confirm that the channel modes were set again; check them.
event_op_restore_failed_topic: Operator status in {channel} is back, but the server did not confirm that the topic was set again; check it.
event_op_topic_too_long: Only you are in {channel} and you lost operator status, but its topic is too long to be set again after rejoining, so it was left as it is.
event_op_not_regained: Joined {channel} again but did not get operator status. Not trying again.
event_op_rejoin_failed: Could not join {channel} again. Not trying again; join it manually.
key_prompt_invalid: A channel key cannot contain spaces, commas or control characters.
key_prompt_rejected: The key was not accepted. Enter it again.
key_prompt_stale: The saved key no longer works.
channel_key_save_failed: Joined {channel}, but the channel key could not be saved: {error}
channel_key_forget_failed: Joined {channel}, but the old saved channel key could not be removed: {error}
event_nick_rejected: The server rejected nickname {nickname} (in use or invalid). Enter another nickname.
wait_join: Wait until the channel is joined before sending.
select_channel: Select a channel before sending a message.
charset_help: /charset — show this channel's encodings; /charset <encoding> — receive and send with it; /charset decode <encoding> — receive only; /charset encode <encoding> — send only; /charset reset — back to the server's. Without an override the server's encoding applies. Supported: {encodings}.
charset_not_channel: /charset applies to a channel. Select a channel tab first; private conversations and the server log have no setting of their own.
help_text:
Main commands in CayenChat (not a complete list of IRC commands; other /commands are sent to the server as typed):
/help — show this list
/join #channel — join a channel
/part [reason] — leave the selected channel
/msg <nick|#channel> text — send a message (the target can be omitted: /msg :text)
/notice <nick|#channel> text — send a NOTICE (the target can be omitted: /notice :text)
/me text — send an action
/nick name — change your nickname
/whois nick — get information about a user
/topic [text] — show or set the topic
/mode ... — show or change modes
/kick nick [reason] — kick a user
/invite nick — invite a user
/names — list the members
/ctcp nick CMD — send a CTCP request
/ping nick — CTCP PING a user (not a raw PING to the server)
/charset [help|...] — show or set the channel's encoding (local command)
/raw command, /quote command — send an IRC command as typed
charset_utf8only: The server requires UTF-8 (UTF8ONLY); only UTF-8 can be set for a channel.
charset_set: Character encoding of {channel} is now: receive {decode}, send {encode}. Messages already shown are not converted again.
charset_reset: Character encoding of {channel} follows the server's again ({encoding}).
charset_reset_none: {channel} has no encoding of its own.
charset_note_utf8only: The server requires UTF-8 (UTF8ONLY), so the settings of other encodings are not used on this connection.
not_connected: Disconnected; open Connection Settings to connect.
draft_placeholder: Message draft — Enter sends, / starts a command
draft_placeholder_ctrl_enter: Message draft — Ctrl+Enter sends, / starts a command
draft_placeholder_double_enter: Message draft — press Enter twice to send, / starts a command
mock_placeholder: Message draft — offline mock, sending disabled
username_hint: Sent in the IRC USER command. It is separate from the nickname and from the SASL account.
display_name_placeholder: Short name for the combined log
event_realname_unsupported: The server does not support SETNAME; the new real name is used from the next connection.
event_realname_busy: Too many real name changes are waiting for the server.
event_realname_rejected: The server rejected the real name: {reason}
server_password_hint: Sent with PASS before registration. This is not the SASL password.
plaintext_pass: Send the server password without TLS
plaintext_pass_warning: The server password is sent unencrypted. Use this only on a trusted network, such as a bouncer on your own LAN.
plaintext_pass_title: Send the server password without TLS?
plaintext_pass_detail: Without TLS, the server password is sent in plain text and anyone who can observe the network can read it. Allow this only for a server on a trusted network, such as your own bouncer.
credential_error_unavailable: The selected credential storage cannot be used ({error}). Choose a location under Settings → Credential Storage.
legacy_migrated: Saved passwords were moved out of the settings file into the credential storage.
legacy_migrated_local: System secure storage is unavailable, so saved passwords were moved out of the settings file into the local credential file. You can change this under Settings → Credential Storage.
credentials_intro: Server passwords, SASL passwords and image hosting accounts are stored separately from other settings.
credential_system_linux: The desktop's Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet or another provider).
credential_local_detail: Less secure. Credentials are stored unencrypted on this computer in {path}. Only your user account can read the file, but any program running as you, and any backup of it, can read them.
credential_system_unavailable: System secure storage is not available ({error}). You can store credentials in a local configuration file instead.
credential_switch_title: Store credentials in a local file?
credential_switch_detail: Credentials will be stored unencrypted in {path}. This is less secure than system secure storage.
credential_switched: Credential storage changed; {count} saved item(s) moved.
credential_switched_source_unavailable: Credential storage changed. Items in the previous location could not be read, so they were not moved.
image_upload_intro: Images you paste or drop into an IRC draft can be uploaded to an image hosting account you own. IRC itself only receives the resulting link as text.
image_upload_privacy: Uploaded images are kept by the hosting service, not by IRC. Anyone who obtains a link may be able to view the image, including people outside the channel; channel membership does not control access.
image_token_placeholder: Paste the API key or token
image_setup_imgbb: ImgBB connects with the API key of your ImgBB account: sign in at api.imgbb.com, choose Get API key, and paste the key here. CayenChat keeps it in the credential storage.
upload_confirm_detail:
“{name}” ({size}) will leave this computer and be sent to {provider}, an external image hosting service. It is not an IRC attachment: a link is added to your draft, and you decide whether to send it.

Anyone who obtains the link may be able to view the image, including people outside this channel. Channel membership does not control access.
upload_not_configured_detail: To send images from IRC, connect an image hosting account.
upload_reconnect_detail: {provider} did not accept the saved account credentials, or none are saved. Reconnect the account to upload images.
upload_cancelled: Upload cancelled. If the transfer had already finished, the image may still exist on {provider}.
upload_busy: An image upload is already in progress.
upload_failed_network: Could not reach {provider} ({error}). The draft was not changed.
upload_failed_rejected: {provider} rejected the image ({error}). The draft was not changed.
upload_failed_too_large: The image is larger than the {limit} upload limit.
upload_not_image: Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF, HEIC/HEIF or AVIF images can be uploaded.
upload_one_file: Drop one image at a time.
upload_drop_hint: Drop an image to upload it
notify_mentions: When someone mentions my nickname in a channel (e.g. nick: or @nick)
notify_private_messages: When I receive a private message
notify_keywords: When a channel message contains a keyword
notify_sound: Play a sound and flash the taskbar button with a notification
keywords_hint: Comma-separated. Matched anywhere in a message, ignoring case. Add your nickname here only if you also want it matched inside other words.
exclude_keywords_hint: Comma-separated, matched ignoring case. A mention or keyword match that overlaps this text is ignored (no notification or highlight); matches elsewhere in the message still count. Private messages still notify.
notifications_hint: Messages in the selected channel of the focused chat window do not notify.
notifications_hint_macos: Messages in the selected channel of the focused chat window do not notify. macOS shows notifications only for the app bundle; allow them in System Settings > Notifications.
ircv3_intro: Optional IRCv3 extensions, chosen for each server. Each stays off until you turn it on.
ircv3_no_server: Add a server on the Connection tab first.
ircv3_server_time_hint: Show the time the server recorded for incoming messages (server-time), in local time. Works without message tags.
ircv3_message_tags_hint: Accept IRCv3 message tags from the server (message-tags). Tag-only messages (TAGMSG) are not shown.
ircv3_batch_hint: Receive grouped messages (batch), so history a server or bouncer replays (chathistory, znc.in/playback) is recognized and does not notify. Other kinds of batches are shown as usual.
ircv3_legacy_encoding: This server uses {encoding}. Message tags are not requested because tag values are UTF-8; server timestamps still work.
ircv3_next_connection: Changes take effect the next time this server connects. A connected server is not reconnected.
ircv3_avatar_waiting_publish: Sending… waiting for the server's answer.
ircv3_avatar_waiting_remove: Removing… waiting for the server's answer.
ircv3_avatar_removed: Removed: the server confirmed that no avatar is set.
ircv3_avatar_rate_limited: The server is limiting changes. Try again in {seconds} s.
ircv3_avatar_rate_limited_later: The server is limiting changes. Try again later.
ircv3_avatar_no_reply: The server did not answer. The avatar may or may not have changed.
ircv3_avatar_unavailable: The avatar cannot be sent to this IRC server now.
ircv3_avatar_busy: Another avatar request is still waiting for the server.
ircv3_avatar_capability_lost: The server stopped avatar metadata before answering.
ircv3_avatar_connection_lost: The connection ended before the server answered.
ircv3_avatar_not_sent: The request could not be sent: {error}
ircv3_avatar_invalid: Enter a web address (http or https) without spaces or control characters.
ircv3_avatar_credentials: This URL contains a user name, password or token-like parameter, so it is not sent.
ircv3_avatar_blocked: Other users could not load this URL: use http or https on the default port with a public host name.
ircv3_avatar_too_long: This URL is too long to send (at most {max} bytes).
ircv3_avatar_ascii_only: This server's encoding allows only avatar URLs written in plain ASCII.
ircv3_avatar_upload_bad_url: The image host returned a URL that cannot be used as an avatar.
ircv3_avatar_upload_server_gone: The server this image was for has been removed; the URL was not kept.
ircv3_avatar_upload_needs_setup: No image upload account is set up. Set one up on the Image Upload tab, or type a URL.
ircv3_avatar_upload_reconnect: Reconnect your {provider} account on the Image Upload tab, or type a URL.
ircv3_avatar_upload_cancelled: Stopped waiting for the upload. The image may still reach the host.
ircv3_avatar_edit_unsupported: This image format cannot be edited here. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP or TIFF (for example, export HEIC photos as JPEG).
ircv3_avatar_edit_too_large: This image is too large to open (at most 8192 pixels a side and about 16 megapixels).
ircv3_avatar_edit_unreadable: This image could not be read.
ircv3_avatar_uploaded_not_sent: Uploaded, but the avatar could not be sent to the IRC server.
ircv3_avatar_exposure: Sending shows this URL to everyone on this network, and the server may keep it. Never include passwords or access tokens.
ircv3_avatar_remove_title: Remove your avatar from the IRC server?
ircv3_avatar_remove_detail: Other users on this network will no longer see it. The URL stays in the field.
ircv3_avatar_unsupported: This IRC server does not support avatars.
ircv3_confirmed_sending_hint: Show your message at once, then let the server confirm it (echo-message, labeled-response): the server's final text and time replace it, and messages the server rejects are marked. Also shows what other clients of the same account send.
ircv3_accounts_hint: Follow the services accounts and real names of channel members (account-notify, extended-join, WHOX) and show them in WHOIS. Asks the server for the members of each joined channel once.
ircv3_chathistory_hint: On joining a channel, ask the server for up to 50 recent lines (draft/chathistory) and show them without notifying. Servers that support it are also asked for timestamps and batches.
ircv3_peer_avatars_hint: Exchange avatar URLs with other clients such as KVIrc, where the server has no avatar metadata. People who speak are looked up with WHO and asked only if they have an avatar. Nothing of yours is shared until you choose Share with Peers.
ircv3_peer_share_exposure: Anyone on this network who asks gets this URL, and after reconnecting your real name shows that you have an avatar. Never include passwords or access tokens.
ircv3_peer_reconnect: Reconnect to update the avatar mark in your real name.
avatar_quick_summary_hidden: Registered: {url} (showing avatars is off on this server)
avatar_quick_notice: Registering publishes the image URL on IRC to other users. Uploading an image also sends it to an external image host. Unchecking this box does not change the registered URL or what is published; stop publishing or remove the icon on the IRCv3 tab.
avatar_quick_local_note: Your own screen shows the saved icon at once. Other users may see it later, or not at all, depending on their client and server support and when they fetch it again.
avatar_quick_return: Back to the icon section of the connection settings
avatar_quick_metadata_offline: IRCv3 Metadata: not connected, so not sent. Connect, then press Register / Update again.
avatar_quick_metadata_unsupported: IRCv3 Metadata: this server does not support it, so nothing is sent.
avatar_quick_metadata_unsent: IRCv3 Metadata: not sent yet. Register / Update sends it.
avatar_quick_ctcp_unsaved: CTCP AVATAR: press Save to turn sharing on.
avatar_quick_ctcp_reconnect: CTCP AVATAR: not applied to the current connection yet. Reconnect to apply it (CayenChat does not reconnect by itself).
avatar_quick_ctcp_stale: CTCP AVATAR: the connection still answers with the previous URL. Press Save again, or reconnect.
avatar_quick_ctcp_ready: CTCP AVATAR: sharing is set up. Others get it once you connect.
reiwa_mode_global_hint: This setting applies to the whole app (all servers).
ircv3_peer_size_placeholder: Other clients do not fill in {size}; share a URL without it.
auto_phrase_hint: Wraps Japanese chat text at natural phrase boundaries (BudouX 0.9.3 model) when it fits the window width. Only the display changes; copied, searched and saved text stays as received. Long words and URLs still wrap anywhere.
debug_log_hint: Changes take effect immediately and are saved for the next launch. Existing files are appended to. Disable logging after troubleshooting; the file keeps growing while enabled. Review logs before sharing them.
debug_log_picker_failed: Could not open the log file chooser.
conversation_log_hint: Off by default. Each day of each conversation is appended to a UTF-8 text file in the folder below; only messages, actions, notices and joins, parts, quits, nick changes, kicks and topic changes seen from now on are saved, never passwords, the server log or replayed history. Private conversations are saved separately, so turning that on writes what people say to you in private to your disk. Turning a log off stops the writing; existing files stay and are yours to manage.
conversation_log_choose_prompt: Choose the folder for conversation logs
conversation_log_failed: Conversation logs could not be written: {error}
conversation_log_locked: Another CayenChat is saving conversation logs to this folder, so this one does not.
conversation_log_dropped: {count} log lines were dropped because the disk could not keep up.
transfer_hint: Write the settings to a file to move them to another computer, or read them from one. Passwords and API tokens are not included.
transfer_export_detail: A copy of the current settings is saved to a file you choose. The current settings file is not changed. The copy holds servers, nicknames, channels, appearance, shortcuts and so on, but no passwords, SASL passwords or upload tokens.
transfer_export_caution: The file contains server names, channel names, nicknames and real names. Mind where you save it and whom you share it with.
transfer_import_summary: {path} holds settings with {servers} server(s) that can be imported.
transfer_import_warn_plain: Does not use TLS: everything, including passwords, is sent in the clear.
transfer_import_warn_unverified: Does not verify the server certificate: anyone on the way can impersonate this server.
transfer_import_warn_plain_pass: May send the server password without TLS.
transfer_import_more: …and {count} more server(s) with safe connection settings.
transfer_import_replaces: Importing replaces all current settings, and every connected server is disconnected. The current settings file is first kept beside it as a backup.
transfer_import_credentials: Passwords, SASL passwords and upload tokens are not imported; enter the ones you need again afterwards. Credentials already saved on this computer are not used for the imported servers.
transfer_import_startup: {count} server(s) are set to connect on startup. Nothing connects now; they connect the next time CayenChat starts.
transfer_import_paths: The debug log file and the conversation log folder of the original computer are not imported.
transfer_import_platform: Settings made on another operating system may not suit this one (key bindings, the Linux display system, window options). Check them after importing. An open settings window is closed.
transfer_import_done: The settings were imported. Some settings, such as the Linux display system, apply the next time CayenChat starts.
transfer_import_backup: The previous settings are kept in {path}.
transfer_import_no_backup: There was no settings file before, so there is no backup.
transfer_import_credentials_after: Credentials were not carried over. Enter the passwords again in each server's settings.
transfer_unchanged: The current settings were not changed.
transfer_picker_failed: The file dialog could not be opened.
transfer_working: Working on the file. Please wait…
wizard_intro: How would you like to get started?
wizard_manual_hint: Choose the server, text encoding, login and channels in the connection settings.
wizard_import_hint: Read the settings from a file exported by CayenChat. Passwords are not included.
wizard_easy_detail: CayenChat connects to IRCnet and joins #CayenChat. Nothing connects until you choose Connect.
wizard_nickname_hint: Others see this name. Choose one you are happy to show; your computer's user name is not used.
wizard_startup_hint: The setup is saved and CayenChat connects on every start. You can change this in the settings.
wizard_save_failed: The settings could not be saved: {error}
wizard_unchanged: Nothing was saved and nothing was connected.
wizard_failed_saved: The settings were saved. Check them in the connection settings and connect again.
